title: Isolation of murine lamina propria CD11c+ cells
protocol: Open peritoneal and pleural cavities of anesthetized mice.

Perfuse mice systemically with 10 ml HBSS containing 20 mM EDTA via the left ventricle using a 21-gauge butterfly needle connected to a Peristaltic pump set at a very slow rate, gradually increasing to high speed until the liver loses color completely.
Collect entire colon or small intestine excluding cecum after perfusion.
Wash collected tissue in PBS to remove fecal contents.
Open longitudinally washed tissues and wipe with paper towel.
Place cleaned tissues into a 2 ml screw cup tube containing 2 ml of HBSS with 2 mM EDTA.
Shake at 4,800 rpm for 50 seconds using the Mini Beadbeater.
Remove muscle layers by tweezers under stereomicroscope.
Incubate tissue pieces in 25 ml of RPMI1640 containing 4% FBS, 1 mg/ml collagenase type II, 1 mg/ml dispase, 40 μg/ml DNase-I and antibiotics for 1 hour at 37°C in a shaking water bath.
Centrifuge samples at 1800 rpm for 5 minutes at 4°C after digestion.
Suspend pellet in 10 ml of HBSS containing 5 mM EDTA and incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes.
Filter digested tissue with a 40 μm cell strainer.
Wash isolated cells twice with MACS buffer.
Purify CD11c-positive cells twice using CD11c MicroBeads according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
